title: Agentic Symbolic Search: Approximating Solutions of PDEs Beyond Hand-crafted Expressions, Meshes, and Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2606.20467v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Numerical methods and neural networks have transformed our understanding of nonlinear partial differential equations (PDEs), yet discovering mathematical representations that explain their dynamics remains largely an expert task. We introduce Agentic Symbolic Search (ASYS), in which coding agents construct and refine explicit approximations from a known PDE and supplied mathematical knowledge. ASYS couples evolutionary search over differentiable symbolic programs with gradient-based fitting, using the governing equation to evaluate candidates and guide their revision. For a singular generalized Constantin-Lax-Majda profile, ASYS infers a missing decay term that sets how fast the field approaches its singular-time limit, and builds a basis that fits the profile to a median error of $3.90\times10^{-5}\%$. For Fujita blow-up, separating diffusion from reaction and deriving a local response lowers the supplied formula's error from 55.5%

translated_title: 智能体符号搜索：超越手工表达式、网格和神经网络的偏微分方程解逼近
translated_abstract: 数值方法和神经网络已经改变了我们对非线性偏微分方程（PDE）的理解，然而发现能够解释其动力学的数学表示在很大程度上仍然是专家的任务。我们提出了智能体符号搜索（ASYS），其中编码智能体从已知的偏微分方程和所提供的数学知识出发，构建并改进显式逼近。ASYS 将可微分符号程序上的进化搜索与基于梯度的拟合相结合，利用控制方程来评估候选解并指导其修正。对于一个奇异的广义 Constantin-Lax-Majda 剖面，ASYS 推断出一个缺失的衰减项，该衰减项决定了场接近其奇异时间极限的速度，并构建了一组基函数，使该剖面的拟合中位误差达到 3.90×10⁻⁵%。对于 Fujita 爆破问题，将扩散与反应分离并推导局部响应，将所提供公式的误差从 55.5%降低
tldr: 提出了智能体符号搜索（ASYS）方法，让编码智能体将可微分符号程序上的进化搜索与基于梯度的拟合相结合，利用控制方程自动构建和改进偏微分方程解的显式逼近，在奇异剖面拟合和爆破问题中实现了极低的误差。
en_tdlr: We introduce Agentic Symbolic Search (ASYS), where coding agents couple evolutionary search over differentiable symbolic programs with gradient-based fitting to automatically construct and refine explicit approximations of PDE solutions, achieving median errors as low as 3.90×10⁻⁵% on singular profiles and significantly reducing errors in Fujita blow-up problems.
